chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
O son of Adam, be your own representative in your property and do with it whatever you prefer to be done with it after you.

key_terms.وَصِيَّ: Executor or representative who manages affairs

ai.seo_question: How should one manage their wealth to ensure it is used according to their wishes after death?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises humanity to act as their own executor (Wasi) regarding their wealth during their lifetime, ensuring that their assets are managed and distributed according to their personal preferences and values after their death. This concept, central to Shia jurisprudence, emphasizes that one's will serves as a binding testament to their moral and spiritual legacy, extending the principle of accountability beyond mere financial distribution to include the preservation of one's ethical stance. It reflects the Shia understanding of personal agency in posthumous affairs, where the individual remains the primary authority over their estate until the final distribution is executed.
